# Wisdom Library

> > Wisdom Library is a comprehensive digital repository of ancient Indian texts, featuring Sanskrit scriptures, Hindu Puranas, Upanishads with commentaries, and interdisciplinary resources spanning philosophy, mythology, and linguistics.

The library specializes in Hindu religious literature including the Skanda Purana (translated by G. V. Tagare), Upanishads with Shankara's Advaita Vedanta commentary, and pilgrimage guides (tirtha-mahatmya). It also provides Sanskrit language resources, alphabet guides for Indian scripts, and a biology portal with taxonomic glossaries.

## Key Topics

- Skanda Purana
- Sanskrit texts and translation
- Hindu Puranas and mythology
- Upanishads (Brihadaranyaka)
- Advaita Vedanta philosophy
- Shankara Bhashya (commentaries)
- Tirtha-mahatmya (pilgrimage literature)
- Dharma and Hindu scripture
- Deities: Shiva, Skanda/Kartikeya/Murugan, Parvati
- Sacred geography: Kedara, Arunacala, Venkatachala
- Vedanta philosophy
- Yajnavalkya teachings
- Motilal Banarsidass publications
- Indian script systems (Malayalam, etc.)
- Sanskrit-English lexicography

## Core Resources

- [Books](https://www.wisdomlib.org/books): Complete catalog of books and texts in Wisdom Library collection

## Hindu Puranas and Epics

- [Skanda Purana](https://www.wisdomlib.org/hinduism/book/the-skanda-purana): English translation of Skanda Purana: 81,000 verses on Hindu mythology

## Upanishads and Vedanta Philosophy

- [Brihadaranyaka Upanishad](https://www.wisdomlib.org/hinduism/book/the-brihadaranyaka-upanishad): Brihadaranyaka Upanishad with Shankara's Advaita Vedanta commentary

## Language and Script Resources

- [Malayalam alphabet: script characters and pronunciation](https://malayalam.wisdomlib.org/malayalam-script): Malayalam alphabet guide with Unicode, IPA, and pronunciation details

## Interdisciplinary Resources

- [Biology Portal](https://www.wisdomlib.org/biology): Biology portal covering five kingdoms: taxonomy and nomenclature glossary

## Optional

- [Generation to generation: Significance and symbolism](https://www.wisdomlib.org/concept/generation-to-generation): Knowledge transmission across generations in Hindu philosophy and grammar
